description: BTS T-100 Segment (All Carriers): monthly passengers, freight, mail, seats, available payload and departures by reporting carrier, aircraft type and airport pair; imported from manual TranStats CSV downloads (no scripted bulk endpoint)

sampling.criteria: Manual TranStats T-100 Segment (All Carriers) CSV export
sampling.reason: TranStats T-100 downloads require an interactive form postback; no scripted bulk file exists (verified 2026-09-15)

source.publisher: US DOT Bureau of Transportation Statistics, Office of Airline Information (TranStats)
source.access_notes: T-100 has no PREZIP bulk file; the TranStats form (ASP.NET postback) must be used in a browser per year/month, then imported with wm import. Plan priority 3: deferred because the link to economic/geopolitical simulations is weak.

normalization.input_format: TranStats CSV or ZIP(CSV) imported with wm import
